correctness.rationale: A parity decomposition proves the edge ideal exhaustively. The Laplacian is computed explicitly in eight parity sectors. The even-sector coefficient map is 9x10 with an exact nonzero minor 110592; the known sextic supplies its one-dimensional kernel. The standalone checker independently replays integer ranks, determinant, harmonicity and all twelve edge restrictions.

value.rationale: The first possible degree and complete one-dimensional class of solutions to the classical cube-edge harmonic vanishing problem are natural sharp complexity and rigidity invariants. All nonhomogeneous candidates up to degree six are treated, not only symmetry-adapted examples.
